summary: INV-01 Project invitation: implemented POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/invitations allowing Workspace Owner to invite managers, members, and viewers, and Project Managers to invite members and viewers only (rejecting manager invitations with 403 FORBIDDEN). Invitations generate cryptographically secure 32-byte tokens stored only as SHA-256 hashes with 7-day expiry, insert durable transactional outbox records for email delivery, and register idempotency receipts. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Outbox queue delivery worker is implemented in INV-02.

evidence.command: npm run typecheck && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false node --test apps/api/test/inv01-inv03.test.ts
evidence.result: Strict typecheck passed with 0 errors; all tests in inv01-inv03 test suite passed (8 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped).
evidence.environment: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, Node 24.15.0, npm 11.12.1, PostgreSQL 17.11 Alpine container.

next_dependency_ready_task: INV-02 (Invitation delivery), INV-04 (Resend and revoke invitation), INV-05 (Pending invitations list), RBAC-05 (Project inheritance disclosure).
